units.text: Article 14.3. Violation of advertising legislation
units.label: Art. 14.3

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.3. Violation of advertising legislation
units.label: Art. 14.3

units.text: 1. Violation of advertising legislation by an advertiser, advertising producer or advertising distributor, except in the cases provided for by Parts 2–17 of this Article, Part 4 of Article 14.3.1, or Articles 14.37, 14.38 or 19.31 of this Code, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, four thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two…”

units.text: 2. Violation of the procedure for interrupting a television or radio programme or broadcast with advertising, or combining advertising with a television programme; exceeding the volume of advertising permitted by advertising legislation in television or radio programmes; or disseminating advertising in television or radio programmes on days of mourning declared in the Russian Federation —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten…”

units.text: 3. Exceeding the volume of advertising permitted by advertising legislation in periodical printed publications —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of four thousand to seven thousand roubles; for legal entities, forty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of four…”

units.text: 4. Interrupting the screening of a film with advertising in cinema and video services, or combining advertising with the screening of a film, a religious television broadcast, a television broadcast of less than fifteen minutes, or the broadcasting of campaign materials disseminated in television programmes and broadcasts in accordance with election and referendum legislation, by means of a scrolling text line or any other form of overlay on a frame of the film, television programme or broadcast being shown, —
units.label: Part 4 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten…”

units.text: 4.1. Violation of the requirements established by advertising legislation for advertising disseminated through telecommunications networks —
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for officials, twenty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to one million roubles.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten…”

units.text: 5. Violation of the requirements established by advertising legislation for advertising medicinal products, medical devices and medical services, including treatment methods, as well as biologically active supplements —
units.label: Part 5 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two…”

units.text: 6. Dissemination by a credit institution or microfinance organisation of advertising for services relating to the provision, use and repayment of a credit or loan in violation of the requirements specified in Part 3 of Article 28 of Federal Law of 13 March 2006 No. 38-FZ “On Advertising” —
units.label: Part 6 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, six hundred thousand to one million six hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty…”

units.text: 7. Dissemination of advertising promoting a foreign legal entity, a foreign organisation without legal personality, a foreign citizen or a stateless person carrying out activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation and/or that foreign person’s information resource as the object of advertising, aimed at attracting the attention of advertising consumers located in the territory of the Russian Federation, where the federal executive body exercising control and supervision over mass media, mass communications, information technology and communications has decided to prohibit dissemination of such advertising and information about that decision has been entered in the list of foreign persons carrying out activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation in accordance with Federal Law of 1 July 2021 No. 236-FZ “On the Activities of Foreign Persons on the Internet Information and Telecommunications Network in the Territory of the Russian Federation”, except in the cases provided for by Part 8 of this Article, —
units.label: Part 7 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twenty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; for officials, eighty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to three million roubles.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twenty…”

units.text: 8. Dissemination by a foreign legal entity, a foreign organisation without legal personality, a foreign citizen or a stateless person carrying out activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation of advertising promoting that foreign person and/or their information resource as the object of advertising, aimed at attracting the attention of advertising consumers located in the territory of the Russian Federation, where the federal executive body exercising control and supervision over mass media, mass communications, information technology and communications has decided to prohibit dissemination of such advertising and information about that decision has been entered in the list of foreign persons carrying out activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation in accordance with Federal Law of 1 July 2021 No. 236-FZ “On the Activities of Foreign Persons on the Internet Information and Telecommunications Network in the Territory of the Russian Federation” —
units.label: Part 8 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for officials, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, three million to six million roubles.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty…”

units.text: 9. Dissemination of advertising on an information resource of a foreign legal entity, a foreign organisation without legal personality, a foreign citizen or a stateless person carrying out activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation, aimed at attracting the attention of advertising consumers located in the territory of the Russian Federation, where the federal executive body exercising control and supervision over mass media, mass communications, information technology and communications has decided to prohibit dissemination of advertising on that information resource and information about that decision has been entered in the list of foreign persons carrying out activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation in accordance with Federal Law of 1 July 2021 No. 236-FZ “On the Activities of Foreign Persons on the Internet Information and Telecommunications Network in the Territory of the Russian Federation”, except in the cases provided for by Part 10 of this Article, —
units.label: Part 9 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twenty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; for officials, eighty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to three million roubles.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twenty…”

units.text: 10. Dissemination by a foreign legal entity, a foreign organisation without legal personality, a foreign citizen or a stateless person carrying out activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation of advertising on that foreign person’s information resource, aimed at attracting the attention of advertising consumers located in the territory of the Russian Federation, where the federal executive body exercising control and supervision over mass media, mass communications, information technology and communications has decided to prohibit dissemination of advertising on that information resource and information about that decision has been entered in the list of foreign persons carrying out activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation in accordance with Federal Law of 1 July 2021 No. 236-FZ “On the Activities of Foreign Persons on the Internet Information and Telecommunications Network in the Territory of the Russian Federation” —
units.label: Part 10 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for officials, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, three million to six million roubles.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty…”

units.text: 11. Failure by an advertising distributor or advertising system operator to fulfil the obligation to send the social advertising operator information on the volume, methods, forms and means of advertising distribution on information resources owned by the advertising distributor and/or forecast volumes of social advertising distribution on the Internet information and telecommunications network, or sending such information and/or forecasts in breach of the established requirements for them or the deadlines and procedure for their submission, —
units.label: Part 11 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for officials, thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten…”

units.text: 12. Failure by an advertising distributor or advertising system operator to fulfil the obligation to enter into an agreement with the social advertising operator for the distribution of social advertising on the Internet information and telecommunications network, or to distribute free of charge on that network the social advertising supplied for distribution by the social advertising operator under that agreement, or to refrain from imposing any form of restriction on the social advertising operator when distributing social advertising in accordance with advertising legislation, except as provided for by that agreement with the social advertising operator, —
units.label: Part 12 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for officials, thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten…”

units.text: 13. Failure by an advertising distributor to fulfil the obligation to notify the social advertising operator that an advertising system operator has been given the ability, under an agreement for the distribution of social advertising on the Internet information and telecommunications network, to distribute advertising on an information resource owned by that advertising distributor —
units.label: Part 13 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for officials, thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten…”

units.text: 14. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 11, 12 or 13 of this Article —
units.label: Part 14 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for officials, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty…”

units.text: 15. Failure by an advertiser, advertising distributor or advertising system operator to fulfil the obligation to provide, or ensure the provision of, information about advertising disseminated on the Internet information and telecommunications network to the federal executive body exercising control and supervision over mass media, mass communications, information technology and communications in accordance with advertising legislation; breach of the prescribed deadlines for fulfilling those obligations; or provision to that body, in fulfilment of those obligations, of incomplete, inaccurate or out-of-date information —
units.label: Part 15 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for officials, thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten…”

units.text: 16. Dissemination of advertising on the Internet information and telecommunications network without an advertising identifier assigned to that advertising by an advertising data operator, or violation of the requirements for placement of that identifier when distributing advertising on that network, —
units.label: Part 16 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for officials, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty…”

units.text: 17. Failure by an advertising data operator to fulfil the obligation to transmit to the federal executive body exercising control and supervision over mass media, mass communications, information technology and communications information supplied to it in accordance with advertising legislation about advertising disseminated on the Internet information and telecommunications network; failure by an advertising data operator to comply with the established procedure for interaction with that body; provision by an advertising data operator of incomplete, inaccurate or out-of-date information to that body; or violation by an advertising data operator of the established requirements for an advertising identifier, its content, or the procedure and deadlines for assigning, storing and submitting it to that body —
units.label: Part 17 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of one…”

units.text: 18. Dissemination of advertising for software and hardware tools for accessing information resources or information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted —
units.label: Part 18 Art. 14.3

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of fifty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; for officials, eighty thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 14.3 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of fifty…”
